items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: So was Eddie Cosby... But we all were studying with him at that time

ctx.x: Anyway, so -- I stayed -- I went to this man and I got carried away. I was intrigued. I didn't know that all these things went on with the trombone. So -- and I'd go from week -- every week I'd go. I worked hard at it. And he was a funny man. He told me, he says if you don't study, don't come back next week. I don't -- I'm not looking for students, he said, because I can get all the students I want.

At the same time I was going to him some top trombone players in some of the top bands were studying with him. Tommy Peterson was studying with him at that time. So was Eddie Cosby. Eddie Cosby's name is Eddie Cosboski, but he changed it to Eddie Cosby. But we all were studying with him at that time, and I didn't know they were going to turn out to
be top trombone players. And they didn't know it was going to happen to me.
